title: Continuous ethnography + telemetry to inform model-fallback & vendor-prioritization playbook
creator: Ava Thompson
description:
Goal: Build a repeatable program (research + telemetry) that produces prioritized, operational signals to drive vendor/model fallback decisions and competitive prioritization for enterprise customers.

Scope: 6-week pilot targeting three enterprise buyer archetypes (RAG-heavy search, customer-support agents, and high-throughput chat). Deliverables: (1) qualitative interview bundle (20 buyer interviews + synthesis), (2) signal taxonomy mapping competitive events -> product actions, (3) dashboard prototype with fallback-ready recommendations and SLA impact estimations, (4) decision playbook for eng and platform teams with trigger thresholds and rollback procedures.

Approach:
- Ethnography: conduct 20 semi-structured interviews split across buyers, SREs, and platform engineers. Capture decision heuristics, fallback tolerance, procurement triggers, and in-field workarounds.
- Telemetry: instrument top-10 customer workloads to capture latency distributions, model-error modes (e.g., hallucination flags, token-explosion), and model-availability events. Correlate with vendor outage signals and region-specific latency spikes.
- Competitive scan: maintain a compact weekly tracker of new model variants, quantization releases, region rollouts, and pricing changes. Link significant events to hypothetical fallback impacts (cost delta, latency delta, quality delta).
- Synthesis: convert qualitative themes + telemetry to concrete thresholds (e.g., 95p latency > 700ms over 5m window => consider fallback to cached variant) and to prioritized mitigation actions.

Success metrics (pilot):
- Actionable signals per month >= 3
- Time-to-first-fallback-recommendation <= 10 business days after signal detection
- Positive stakeholder feedback (PM/Eng/Sales) >= 80% on usefulness

Acceptance criteria:
- Completed interview synth doc with personas and 3 prioritized pain narratives
- Working dashboard prototype linked to sample telemetry with at least two pre-configured triggers
- Playbook with 5 explicit fallback actions mapped to signal severity

Out-of-scope for pilot: fully automated throttling or policy enforcement; production rollout of fallback automation (this will be a follow-up).
